what: On the very first workout's finish screen, show 'Next time, beat these' with the best set of each lift (for example 'Bench 40 kg x 10')
why: The first workout deliberately shows no records, so the screen most new members see has no reason to come back for workout 2
impact_why: Workout 2 is where most new members drop off; this gives them a target the moment they finish
my_view: My view: do it; the sets are already on screen, it only picks the best one per lift. Keeps the honest rule of no fake records.

what: On the finish screen, add the badge the member is closest to ('3 more workouts to your 25 workouts badge'), when no new badge was earned
why: Badge progress is only shown on the Badges page, which few members open; the finish screen only says when one was earned
impact_why: Seen after every workout, turns the badge shelf into a reason to train again this week
my_view: My view: do it; the progress words already exist, show only one line, and only when it is within reach (for example 80 percent done).

what: Give a followed plan an end: ready programs carry a length (for example 8 or 12 weeks), and at the end the member sees 'Plan done' with what got stronger and a choice: repeat it a little heavier, or pick the next plan
why: A followed plan's week number only counts up; nothing ever says the plan is finished or what to do next
impact_why: A clear finish line and a next step keep members past month 2-3, when program apps (Fitbod, JEFIT, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) push a new block
my_view: My view: worth it after the free-plan basics; start with the ready programs only, gym plans keep their trainer's own length.

what: Let a member who finished the gym's workout of the day post a result (time or top weight) to a 'Today at <gym>' board other members of the gym can see, opt-in
why: The workout of the day only goes one way: the gym posts it, the member starts it, and nothing comes back to the gym or to other members
impact_why: Box-gym apps (SugarWOD, Wodify, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) are built on this whiteboard; it makes the gym's feature visibly used and gives owners a reason to keep posting
my_view: My view: not yet; first check how many gyms post a workout of the day. If a few do it daily, this is the next step, opt-in and first name only.

what: After two weeks on a plan the gym's trainer sent, ask once 'How is this plan?' (Too easy, Just right, Too hard) and send the answer to that trainer
why: Gym plans arrive on the phone and update, but the member has no way to tell the trainer how it is going
impact_why: Gives trainers a reason to adjust plans and talk to members, which owners sell as personal attention
my_view: My view: do it after gym plans are switched on for real gyms; one question, one tap, shown in the trainer's member page.

what: Under 'Ask your own AI', let the member pick the question at the end of the text: get stronger, build muscle, fix a weak muscle, or plan my next 4 weeks
why: The copied text always ends with the same question, so a member with a different goal has to edit it by hand in the chat app
impact_why: Small, but makes the free AI answer fit the member, which is the point of the feature
my_view: My view: do it; four fixed choices, no typing, nothing new leaves the phone.

what: Remove the AI-written finish note (Groq, behind a switch) and keep the plain fact note
why: It needs the coach switch, a setting and a Groq key, so almost nobody sees it, and the fact note already says what happened
impact_why: Less to keep alive: Groq has already retired models without warning once (Oct 2026)
my_view: My view: remove it unless the coach comes back; one fewer paid call and one fewer thing that can fail quietly.

what: When a forgotten workout pauses itself, the next app open asks 'Did you finish at 7:42 pm?' with Save, Keep going and Discard, instead of only showing a paused workout
why: The pause is back-dated and silent; the member finds a paused workout later and has to work out what to do
impact_why: Saves a confused moment and stops half-saved workouts sitting open for days
my_view: My view: do it; the end time is already worked out, this only asks the question once.

what: On a member's 10th, 25th, 50th and 100th workout, offer a share picture of the milestone ('My 50th workout') with the gym's name or the app's name
why: The milestone line shows on the finish screen but has no share of its own, and the code notes these are the most-shared moments among lifters
impact_why: A free word-of-mouth moment that brings in friends and gyms at no cost
my_view: My view: do it, reusing the existing workout share picture with the milestone as its title; no body weight on it.
